03-15-1006 is March 15, 1006.  
24 weeks = 168 days. Plus 1 day = 169 days before.  
March 15 minus 169 days:  
1006 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in Feb 1006 = 28.  
Back from March 15:  
March 15 → March 1 = 14 days back (leaves 155 days more).  
Feb 28 days back → Feb 1 (28 days back, leaves 127 days).  
Jan 31 days back → Jan 1 (31 days back, leaves 96 days).  
Go into previous year 1005 (not leap, divisible by 4? 1005/4=251.25, not leap).  
Dec 31 days (96-31=65), Nov 30 days (65-30=35), Oct 31 days (35-31=4).  
Oct 1 minus 4 days = Sep 27, 1005.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1005-09-27
